description: A clip's speed, in pixels. The source is three seconds, one colour a second: red, then green, then blue. `c-quick` plays it at 2x, so the whole three seconds fit in 45 frames of timeline and the colour changes at output frames 15 and 30 rather than 30 and 60 — frames 14/15 and 29/30 sit either side of those, and a puller that still assumed one source frame per timeline frame would show red at every one of them. `c-slow` plays the same source at 0.5x from one second in, so a single band is held for twice as long: frame 90 is 45 frames into that clip and must still be green, where at 1x it would long since have reached blue. Frames 44 and 45 are the cut between the two, which a speed must not move.
